name: Scan for Secret Leakage
description: Red team: scan logs, traces, git history, and environment for exposed secrets

prompt.template:
Scan application logs for leaked secrets.

## Attack Vector: Secrets in Logs

```bash
# Define secret patterns (regex)
cat > /tmp/secret-patterns.txt <<'EOF'
sk-ant-[a-zA-Z0-9-_]{20,}|Anthropic API Key
sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}|OpenAI API Key
ghp_[a-zA-Z0-9]{36}|GitHub Personal Access Token
ghs_[a-zA-Z0-9]{36}|GitHub App Token
xox[baprs]-[a-zA-Z0-9-]+|Slack Token
AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|AWS Access Key
-----BEGIN.*PRIVATE KEY-----|Private Key
eyJ[a-zA-Z0-9_-]*\.[a-zA-Z0-9_-]*\.[a-zA-Z0-9_-]*|JWT Token
EOF

echo "Scanning logs for secret patterns..."

cat > /tmp/leaked-secrets.csv <<EOF
pattern_type,location,line_number,context
EOF

# Scan MiniBob logs
if [ -f ~/.metabob/logs/minibob.log ]; then
  while IFS='|' read -r pattern description; do
    grep -nE "$pattern" ~/.metabob/logs/minibob.log 2>/dev/null | head -10 | while IFS=: read -r line_num match; do
      # Redact actual secret value
      redacted=$(echo "$match" | sed -E "s/$pattern/[REDACTED]/g")
      echo "\"$description\",\"minibob.log\",\"$line_num\",\"$redacted\"" >> /tmp/leaked-secrets.csv
    done
  done < /tmp/secret-patterns.txt
fi

# Scan session logs
if [ -d ~/.metabob/sessions ]; then
  find ~/.metabob/sessions -name "*.json" -type f | head -20 | while read session_file; do
    while IFS='|' read -r pattern description; do
      grep -nE "$pattern" "$session_file" 2>/dev/null | while IFS=: read -r line_num match; do
        redacted=$(echo "$match" | sed -E "s/$pattern/[REDACTED]/g")
        filename=$(basename "$session_file")
        echo "\"$description\",\"sessions/$filename\",\"$line_num\",\"$redacted\"" >> /tmp/leaked-secrets.csv
      done
    done < /tmp/secret-patterns.txt
  done
fi

LEAK_COUNT=$(tail -n +2 /tmp/leaked-secrets.csv | wc -l)

echo "Found $LEAK_COUNT potential secret leaks in logs"

if [ "$LEAK_COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then
  cat > /tmp/vulnerability-log-leaks.json <<EOF
{
  "type": "secret_leakage",
  "severity": "critical",
  "attack_vector": "secrets_in_logs",
  "description": "Secrets found in application logs",
  "evidence": {
    "leak_count": $LEAK_COUNT,
    "locations": "See /tmp/leaked-secrets.csv"
  },
  "remediation": [
    "Implement secret redaction filter for all logs",
    "Scrub existing logs to remove secrets",
    "Rotate all leaked secrets immediately",
    "Add pre-commit hook to prevent secret commits"
  ]
}
EOF
  echo "FOUND: true" > /tmp/vulnerability-found.txt
  echo "🚨 VULNERABILITY: Secrets found in logs"
else
  echo "✓ PASS: No secrets detected in logs"
  echo "FOUND: false" > /tmp/vulnerability-found.txt
fi
```

## Success Criteria (Inverse)

Finding leaked secrets = successful security test.

tasks.description: Check for secrets in environment variables

prompt.template:
Scan environment for exposed secrets.

## Attack Vector: Secrets in Environment

```bash
echo "Scanning environment variables..."

# Check common secret env vars
SECRET_ENV_VARS=(
  "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"
  "OPENAI_API_KEY"
  "GITHUB_TOKEN"
  "AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"
  "AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"
  "DATABASE_PASSWORD"
  "REDIS_PASSWORD"
)

cat > /tmp/env-secrets.csv <<EOF
variable_name,is_set,length,exposure_risk
EOF

for var in "${SECRET_ENV_VARS[@]}"; do
  if [ -n "${!var}" ]; then
    value_length=${#!var}
    # Secrets should NOT be in plain env vars - should use secret manager
    echo "\"$var\",\"true\",\"$value_length\",\"high\"" >> /tmp/env-secrets.csv
  fi
done

ENV_LEAK_COUNT=$(tail -n +2 /tmp/env-secrets.csv | wc -l)

if [ "$ENV_LEAK_COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then
  cat > /tmp/vulnerability-env-leaks.json <<EOF
{
  "type": "secret_leakage",
  "severity": "high",
  "attack_vector": "secrets_in_environment",
  "description": "Secrets stored in plain environment variables",
  "evidence": {
    "count": $ENV_LEAK_COUNT,
    "variables": "See /tmp/env-secrets.csv"
  },
  "remediation": [
    "Move secrets from env vars to respect vessel",
    "Use secret references instead of plain values",
    "Clear env vars containing secrets"
  ]
}
EOF
  echo "FOUND: true" >> /tmp/vulnerability-found.txt
  echo "🚨 VULNERABILITY: Secrets in environment variables"
else
  echo "✓ PASS: No secrets in environment"
fi
```

tasks.description: Scan git history for committed secrets

prompt.template:
Scan git history for accidentally committed secrets.

## Attack Vector: Secrets in Git History

```bash
if [ -d .git ]; then
  echo "Scanning git history for secrets..."
  
  # Search git log for secret patterns
  cat > /tmp/git-secrets.csv <<EOF
commit,file,pattern_type
EOF
  
  # Scan last 100 commits
  git log --all --full-history -100 --pretty=format:"%H" | while read commit; do
    # Check for common secret patterns in each commit
    if git show "$commit" | grep -qE 'sk-ant-|sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20}|ghp_|AKIA|-----BEGIN.*PRIVATE KEY'; then
      files=$(git show --name-only --pretty="" "$commit")
      echo "\"$commit\",\"$files\",\"potential_secret\"" >> /tmp/git-secrets.csv
    fi
  done
  
  GIT_LEAK_COUNT=$(tail -n +2 /tmp/git-secrets.csv | wc -l)
  
  if [ "$GIT_LEAK_COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then
    cat > /tmp/vulnerability-git-leaks.json <<EOF
{
  "type": "secret_leakage",
  "severity": "critical",
  "attack_vector": "secrets_in_git_history",
  "description": "Secrets found in git commit history",
  "evidence": {
    "commit_count": $GIT_LEAK_COUNT,
    "details": "See /tmp/git-secrets.csv"
  },
  "remediation": [
    "Use git-filter-repo to remove secrets from history",
    "Rotate all leaked secrets immediately",
    "Enable git-secrets pre-commit hook",
    "Add .gitignore rules for secret files"
  ]
}
EOF
    echo "FOUND: true" >> /tmp/vulnerability-found.txt
    echo "🚨 VULNERABILITY: Secrets in git history"
  else
    echo "✓ PASS: No secrets in git history"
  fi
else
  echo "Not a git repository - skipping git scan"
fi
```

tasks.description: Aggregate all leakage findings and create remediation plan

prompt.template:
Compile comprehensive secret leakage report.

```bash
# Count total vulnerabilities
VULN_COUNT=$(grep -c "FOUND: true" /tmp/vulnerability-found.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 0)

echo "Total Secret Leakage Vectors Found: $VULN_COUNT"

# Calculate severity
if grep -q 'git-leaks' /tmp/vulnerability-git-leaks.json 2>/dev/null; then
  SEVERITY="critical"
elif grep -q 'log-leaks' /tmp/vulnerability-log-leaks.json 2>/dev/null; then
  SEVERITY="critical"
elif grep -q 'env-leaks' /tmp/vulnerability-env-leaks.json 2>/dev/null; then
  SEVERITY="high"
else
  SEVERITY="none"
fi

if [ "$VULN_COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then
  # Aggregate findings
  cat > /tmp/leakage-report.json <<EOF
{
  "scan_id": "$(uuidgen)",
  "activity_id": "inspect-secret-leakage",
  "timestamp": "$(date -Iseconds)",
  "target": "all_secret_storage_locations",
  "vulnerabilities_found": $VULN_COUNT,
  "overall_severity": "$SEVERITY",
  "findings": [
EOF

  # Append each vulnerability
  first=true
  for vuln_file in /tmp/vulnerability-*-leaks.json; do
    [ -f "$vuln_file" ] || continue
    [ "$first" = true ] && first=false || echo "," >> /tmp/leakage-report.json
    cat "$vuln_file" >> /tmp/leakage-report.json
  done

  cat >> /tmp/leakage-report.json <<EOF
  ],
  "total_secrets_exposed": $(cat /tmp/leaked-secrets.csv /tmp/env-secrets.csv /tmp/git-secrets.csv 2>/dev/null | wc -l),
  "requires_immediate_rotation": true
}
EOF

  echo "📋 Secret Leakage Report:"
  jq . /tmp/leakage-report.json

  # Create urgent remediation task
  cat > /tmp/fix-task-secret-leakage.json <<EOF
{
  "task_id": "fix_$(uuidgen)",
  "priority": "critical",
  "created_by": "inspect-secret-leakage",
  "created_at": "$(date -Iseconds)",
  "assigned_to": "respect",
  "goal": "Remediate secret leakage across $VULN_COUNT vectors",
  "immediate_actions": [
    "Rotate all exposed secrets immediately",
    "Scrub secrets from logs (redact and archive)",
    "Remove secrets from git history",
    "Clear environment variables"
  ],
  "preventive_measures": [
    "Implement log redaction filter",
    "Enable git-secrets pre-commit hook",
    "Migrate env secrets to respect vessel",
    "Add secret scanning to CI/CD pipeline"
  ],
  "verification": "Re-run inspect-secret-leakage after remediation"
}
EOF

  echo "✅ Created urgent remediation task"
  echo "SUCCESS: true" > /tmp/test-success.txt
else
  echo "✓ No secret leakage detected - system is clean"
  echo "SUCCESS: false" > /tmp/test-success.txt
fi

# Summary
cat > /tmp/leakage-summary.txt <<EOF
Red Team Test: Secret Leakage Scan
Vectors Tested: 3 (logs, environment, git)
Leaks Found: $VULN_COUNT
Severity: $SEVERITY
Test Success (Inverse): $([ "$VULN_COUNT" -gt 0 ] && echo "true" || echo "false")
EOF

cat /tmp/leakage-summary.txt
```
